We are both customer focused and eager to help the end-users of our products and services to become more efficient in their network maintenance by saving time and ultimately costs. Instance customers are manufacturers, distributors and installers of life safety electronic equipment as well as companies that have large electronic communication networks.

Although the Instance product range applies to many industries, the products were (to a large extent) inspired by part 13 of the EN54 life safety fire detection and fire alarm system standard. In essence part 13 is a standard for system performance where time is critical for life and safety against fire. With our focus on the uptime of communication networks and the improvement of the Quality of Service (QoS) of industrial networks, EN54-13 provided an important benchmark for our engineering development.

Name: ZDZW project
Description:
ZDZW excels in offering a catalogue of IoT based non-destructive inspection technologies, providing an accurate inline evaluation of key product parameters that have an effect in quality requirements within different technical areas, such as: Part Integrity, Visual Requirements and Thermal Process efficiency. The ZDZW Inspection Solutions follow the concept of Inspection as a service, guaranteeing its cost effectiveness and improved return of investment, offering different types of subscription and pay-per-use models depending on the offered functionalities. To pursue the main goal of reducing defects and the waste generated in manufacturing processes, ZDZW addresses defects and waste reduction in three key areas that cover the entire manufacturing process and product lifecycle: (i) Monitoring and control improvement for process quality assurance, where first-time-right  manufacturing rate can be increased, including improved durability properties and reduced waste generation; (ii) digitally enhanced Rework & Repair procedures for necessary part recovery and scrap reduction; and (iii) Continuous Sustainability evaluation to ensure the efficient use of materials and components across the full production line. ZDZW is strongly supported by collaboration with relevant EU initiatives such as ZDMP and i4Q, providing components and services that enhance key ICT aspects such as interoperability, interlinking, security, data reliability and digital platforms. ZDZW will demonstrate its ZD and ZW approach in 6 Pilots involving production processes with an important waste reduction potential, such as injection moulding, thermoforming, welding and coating, induction hardening, lithography and packaging, involving key industrial sectors as automotive, home appliances, renewable energy, e-health, and food and beverages.

Tenemos diferentes tecnologías de impresión 3D para dar el mejor servició y los mejores resultados según el funcionamiento requerido del componente. Las tecnologías de impresión que trabajamos son SLA, FDM y FFF, equipos industriales para dar un buen acabado, gran formato de pieza, repetibilidad. Con la tecnología de FFF podemos augmentar las propiedades mecánicas de la pieza impresas en 3D. Para obtener esos resultados añadimos fibras continuas: kevlar, fibras de vidrio y fibras de carbono, ajustando el porcentaje y la disposición de fibras según la funcionalidad de tenga que cumplir la pieza. Con la aportación de fibras podemos igualar las propiedades mecánicas del aluminio con una reducción de peso y donde la complejidad de la geometría de la pieza no es un problema.
SECTOR DEL ESCANEO 3D: Obtención del modelo 3D directamente de una muestra física. El modelo obtenido puede ser utilizado: para ser fabricado en mecanizado, impresión 3D..., para hacer ingeniería inversa, para recuperar el diseño del componente, para diseñar útiles...
SECTOR MECANIZADO: Especializados en la mecanización de todo tipos de aluminios (6062, 7075...) y resinas (DELRIN, ERTACETAL...), con la entrega de piezas con la posibilidad de múltiple acabados superficiales, con muchos años de experiencia.
Con las 3 disciplinas podemos ofrecer una solución híbrida de los 3 sectores con un asesoramiento ingenieril especializado en el diseño y en la fabricación de los 3 sectores, con capacidad de diseño.

Name: Avantime
Description:
Avantime Group comprises Avantime Technologies, Avantime Consulting, and Avantime Humanitarian.

AVANTIME TECHNOLOGIES
In its essence, Avantime Technologies is an initiative to take onto the betterment of safety, health, and personnel and mechanical efficiency of the industrial world. Through the automation of processes, such as the tracking of maintenance of heavy machinery, Avantime ensures that its products and services can make a positive impact in the workplace of millions of people around the world.

AVANTIME CONSULTING
Technically named Avantime Consulting and Grants Research, this branch focuses on finding the most efficient solutions for those entities interested in strengthening their efforts towards the assuaging of climate change. Avantime Group aims at working alongside government and regulatory bodies to study the best-balanced way to distribute grants destined for eco-friendly movements an efforts.

AVANTIME HUMANITARIAN
A non-profit branch of Avantime Group, Avantime Humanitarian's scope is to offer advice and consulting services regarding humanitarian relief an aid for all those entities (governments, NGOs, activist groups, etc.) involved in such efforts. In a way to give back to society, Avantime Humanitarian's services and products are 100% free of charge.

Name: darwindata
Description:
DarwinData es un servicio de Cloud Data Logging privado con representación gráfica en navegador web apto para:

-Captura masiva y Registro de Datos, Eventos e Ítems On-Line para máquinas, procesos, equipos industriales, instrumentos y todo tipo de generadores de información digital
-Vigilancia de  instalaciones con  control de accesos
-Entornos y elementos que requieren trazabilidad
-Monitoreo de Condiciones (Condition monitoring)
-Análisis de series de temporales de Variables en Plantas de Procesos
-Ejecuta un análisis y ordenación de datos  para representación gráfica en  páginas web (testeado con Internet Explorer-10 , Chrome, Firefox o Safari) de forma continua y en tiempo real mediante servidores Cloud, sin la necesidad de utilizar equipos especiales de almacenaje y procesado en la instalación del cliente. Es una aplicación completa para el registro de datos en instrumentación de medida y PLC’s, controles de acceso, seguimiento de la producción y  estado de equipos

Diseñado para múltiples entornos, ejecuta las tareas de gestión de datos  en la nube. Con una conexión a internet  de sus equipos, nuestros servidores realizarán  todos los trabajos necesarios para obtener una representación ágil  y eficaz de la información recogida.
